surbase.definition: n. the molding or border above the base of a structure (a pedestal or podium or wall)

surbased.definition:
a. Having a surbase, or molding above the base.
a. Having the vertical height from springing line to crown
   less than the half span; -- said of an arch; as, a segmental arch is
   surbased.
surbased.translation: a. 有台基上部装饰线脚的, 扁拱形的
